svg.title: Branch Protection: Reviewed, Tested and Current
svg.desc: A direct push to main is rejected, while a pull request passes required approvals, fresh approval after new commits, required checks and resolved conversations before it can merge.
svg.text: Branch Protection: Reviewed, Tested and Current
A direct push is rejected; a pull request merges only after every required gate passes.
The only way changes enter main
Direct push with no pull request
Force pushes and deletions stay blocked
